plugins.description: Reusable, self-improving Claude Code development harness: a staged workflow, specialist agent roles, an ISO/IEC 25010 standards catalog, and deterministic architecture enforcement — with three live skills, /claugentic-dev-harness:init (scaffold), /claugentic-dev-harness:audit (audit → backlog), and /claugentic-dev-harness:build (drive one backlog item through the reviewed pipeline).
